items.summary: On subcategory pages (route pattern `/products/$categorySlug/$subcategorySlug`), change the product card interaction so clicking any product card opens a centered modal (quick-view) instead of navigating to a new page, while keeping the existing routing structure intact.

Implement the modal backdrop and open/close behavior: apply a semi-transparent dark overlay with `backdrop-filter: blur(6px)`, disable background scroll while open, and support closing via (1) a close button in the top-right, (2) clicking outside the modal, and (3) pressing the ESC key.

Match the requested premium modal layout and responsive behavior: desktop/tablet shows a two-column layout with a large product image on the left and content on the right; mobile stacks with the image on top and content below. Content must include: product title (large serif), a 3–5 line description, a bullet feature list, and a “Send Inquiry” button.

Apply the exact modal styling and animation: modal background `#141F33`, subtle 1px gold border, soft glow shadow, and open/close animation using a subtle fade + scale (duration 0.3s ease; scale 0.95→1 and opacity 0→1 on open; reverse on close). The “Send Inquiry” button must use gold `#C8A24D` with dark navy text and hover effects (slight lift + slight darkening).

Wire the modal “Send Inquiry” button to navigate to the existing contact page route (`/contact`) and prefill the category in the same way the current subcategory page CTA does (keeping existing inquiry flow intact).

Replace the current site logo in both header and footer with the uploaded image file `Screenshot_2026-02-15_at_3.36.48_AM-removebg-preview.png`, ensuring: high-resolution usage, the header logo renders at ~2× the current size while keeping the header height unchanged, aspect ratio is preserved (no stretching), the logo remains vertically centered, and spacing around the logo is maintained. Update the footer logo to match the new asset as well.
